text: out of rock, old faces look on calmly, as their priestly hieroglyphs, their lovers' curves, their treasuries of water are revealed in the stems and leaves of living stone. On the shore, whittled and bleached by the sea, another branch of sculpture, above the roofs and in the courtyards of elsewhere totems of steel, hidden caves of concrete, giant transparencies of structure, monumental postures of bronze, imprints of plaster, lard of survival,
